Code Review ✅ Approved 🟡 Medium risk · Lowercasing Vertica catalog names changes view-definition matching, so a case-colliding name could return the wrong SQL definition and produce incorrect lineage. Fixes Vertica view definition lookup to match view names case-insensitively by comparing `lower(table_name)` with the lowercased name, so mixed-case views like `MyView` now return their definition and `CREATE VIEW` prefix. No issues found.
